gen-gf-pangolin-fs-hind: Pangolin draws tall, generous lowercase with a single nib, loose and friendly, while Hind follows in a plain sans with lowercase close to its capitals. Its c endings never curl inward.
gen-gf-pangolin-fs-hoover: Hand-drawn and easygoing, with a tall lowercase and unvarying lines from Pangolin. Hoover, a serif with a compressed ascender length and a generous entry into the e, adds a sturdier, more refined tone beside it.
gen-gf-pangolin-fs-technor: Friendly pen strokes meet neon tubes. Pangolin leans relaxed and handwritten, while Technor, a sans-serif with one glowing line thickness and little height difference between cases, brings the coolest, most geometric edge to the pair.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: Commanding, this heading font is. Paprika fills the line with lowercase like capitals, and BhuTuka Expanded One slows a long passage to a leisurely walk, its serif curves loose and unclamped.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-hepta-slab: Hepta Slab takes the lead with a bookish, dignified serif. Paprika's lowercase is far taller, though, and that shift in height is what gives the pair its most memorable quality.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-kiwi-maru: Loud, scattered display letters sit up top, with Paprika's lowercase filling the line like capitals above a calmer, traditional serif. Kiwi Maru's generous letterspace lets it breathe underneath.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-padyakke-expanded-one: Paprika scatters its letters wide, with a lowercase that fills the line. Padyakke Expanded One answers as a text serif with round bowls and wide-mouthed c shapes, so Paprika is best kept big and short.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-stint-ultra-expanded: Paprika is the showman, filling each line with big lowercase and hollow, breathing counters. And Stint Ultra Expanded, a serif with floating characters and open counters, is the one to carry the traditional, authoritative voice.
gen-gf-patrick-hand-sc-fs-amulya: Relaxed pen-and-paper letters in Patrick Hand SC crowd together with thin slivers of white between them, while Amulya, a plain sans, keeps its curves open and contemporary. Brief copy suits this pair best.
gen-gf-patrick-hand-sc-fs-bespoke-sans: Casual and loose, Patrick Hand SC draws monoline letters with a handwritten feel, set against Bespoke Sans, a plain sans that looks sharp and refined. The heading brings the warmth; the body does the tidy reading.
